description: Go encoder and decoder for OpenStreetMap PBF files, with the pbf CLI
rules: Import the module as m4o.io/pbf/v2. github.com/maguro/pbf is not an import path.
Decoder.Decode returns a batch ([]model.Entity). Loop until it returns io.EOF, and always call Decoder.Close.
Entities are pointers: *model.Node, *model.Way, and *model.Relation. Pass pointers to Encoder.Encode and Encoder.EncodeBatch.
Set a non-nil Info on every entity that you encode. Set Info.Visible to true for current data.
Call Encoder.Close once, after the last Encode call. The output is not complete until Close returns.
